<!-- pr-reviewer: b253b6a600adc6f58914f5ddf56bfab675f9118f -->
**Not built - needs a maintainer look.**

Read, not built. This is a fork PR from FlamingFireCoding (non-collaborator), so per the review rules it is built locally and `pr-test.yml` is not started. The build could not run here: this environment has no C toolchain (`cc` / `gcc` / `clang` all absent - `error: linker cc not found`), and the workspace needs C (flecs_ecs_sys, crc32fast). Nothing here is a pass; nothing here confirms the change works. A collaborator must build this head before it merges.

**What looks good**

- The stated-axis resolver (`rotary_stated::lines_of`, `motion/src/multiaxis/axis_stated.rs`) is read-only over the document plus the judged line, with a refusal by name for a leaning or empty direction, and never a silent fall back to the free fit ("Never a silent fall back" - matches the resolver's own order).
- The judge is the fit's own gate about the stated line, and each radius is read about the stated line (`holds_data`, `d.p - ax.origin`) - the review's +10000 mm mutation is pinned (motion `a_wrong_line_refuses_on_every_plane_wherever_the_part_sits`, app `a_common_translation_does_not_defeat_the_stated_line_judge`).
- The kernels grow `*_stated` entries over the same bodies; the plain entries keep the fit inside, so turning/drilling/golden paths are untouched, and the sim consumers (`fixture::rotary_axis_of`, `rotary_law::rotary_into`, the revolved bar, the letter door) all read the resolved axis. Nothing stated keeps today's behaviour bit for bit.
- The project step is clean: v81 (not v78), a breaking change with a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer on the rework commit, and the old-reader boundary pinned across all three rotary kinds (`a_stated_axis_on_every_rotary_kind_needs_the_new_reader`, `a_stated_axis_round_trips_the_project_file`).
- UI: the group rides the existing `EditOperationParams` commit (one undoable command, one undo restores the op), help text follows the resolver's order, and structural tests cover labels/roles/enabled state across all three kinds.
- The merge with main is clean (union; the only main-side change folded in is #3956's Cargo.toml workspace-dep removal). No snapshot PNGs, goldens, or process files touched.

**Results**

- Trial merge with main (`4329c5be5`): clean, no conflicts.
- Build: not run - the environment has no C toolchain (`cc` not found). No test suites executed; clippy not run. This is not a pass.

**Targeted tests**

- Not run (not built). The PR body names the pinning tests and the author says they are green on this head (motion `axis_stated_tests`, app `rotary_stated_axis`, ui `rotary_stated_axis`); those are unverified by me.

**Requested before merge** (not blocking on my part - they belong to whoever builds):

1. Run the quick gate and the touched suites on this head: `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib` and the `axis_stated_tests`, `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test rotary_stated_axis` (plus `rotary_letter`, `rotary_verify`, `project_roundtrip`, `operations`), `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (the new `rotary_stated_axis` structural tests), `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`. Confirm the author's claimed green result on this head (`b253b6a6`).
2. Minor: the comment block `The radius is the facet's distance FROM THE STATED LINE...` in `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/axis_stated.rs` (the `holds_data` function) is pasted twice in a row - worth a one-line dedup, not a blocker.

**Notes**

- mkinney's SAFETY review requested changes on head `5d1ee3dc`; the rework commits (`d69361b36`, `b253b6a60`) address the seven items (radius-about-the-stated-line, v81, the union merge, screenshots, UI structural tests, help text, regenerated example) - verified by reading. No collaborator review exists on this head.
- The `needs-rework` and stale `conflicts` labels were removed as this head is no longer the head they named; this review replaces them.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
